passages.title: Shuleni

passages.title: Chakula cha asubuhi
sentences: Salim anaamka mapema kila siku.
Salim wakes up early every day.

passages.title: Barua kwa rafiki
sentences: Habari yako, Zawadi?
How are you, Zawadi?
Mimi ni mzima na ninaishi vizuri hapa Dodoma.

passages.title: Paka wetu
sentences: Tuna paka mmoja anayeitwa Simba.

passages.title: Safari ya Mombasa
sentences: Jina langu ni Hassani na ninaishi Nairobi.

sentences: Leo ni siku ya kuzaliwa ya Asha na ametimiza miaka kumi na miwili.
Today is Asha's birthday and she has turned twelve.
Wazazi wake wameandaa sherehe ndogo nyumbani jioni.
Her parents have prepared a small party at home in the evening.
Mama yake alipika chakula kizuri na keki kubwa asubuhi.
Her mother cooked good food and a big cake in the morning.
Baba yake alinunua maziwa na matunda dukani.
Her father bought milk and fruit at the shop.
Asha aliwaita rafiki zake sita kutoka darasani.
Asha called six of her friends from class.
Wageni walifika saa kumi na moja wakiwa na zawadi mikononi.
The guests arrived at five with presents in their hands.
Walicheza michezo mingi nje ya nyumba.
They played many games outside the house.
Kisha wote walikaa pamoja na kunywa chai.
Then they all sat together and drank tea.
Asha alikata keki na kila mtu alipata kipande.
Asha cut the cake and everybody got a piece.
Zawadi aliyoipenda zaidi ilikuwa kitabu kutoka kwa babu yake.
The present she liked most was a book from her grandfather.
Usiku, baada ya wageni kuondoka, Asha aliwashukuru wazazi wake.
At night, after the guests left, Asha thanked her parents.
Alisema ilikuwa siku bora ya mwaka.
She said it was the best day of the year.

questions.en: How old is Asha today?
Asha's mother made a cake.

questions.q: Asha aliwaita rafiki zake wote wa shule.
questions.en: Asha called all her school friends.
Which present did Asha like most?
Asha thanked her parents.

passages.title: Tangazo la kazi
sentences: Kampuni ya usafiri inatafuta madereva watatu kwa magari yake mapya ya abiria.
A transport company is looking for three drivers for its new passenger vehicles.
Kazi ni ya kudumu na mshahara ni mzuri.
The job is permanent and the salary is good.
Mtu anayeomba kazi hii anapaswa kuwa na leseni ya kuendesha gari ya daraja la kwanza.
A person applying for this job should have a first-class driving licence.
Anapaswa kuwa na uzoefu wa miaka mitano angalau.
He should have at least five years of experience.
Pia anapaswa kujua barabara za Mwanza na miji ya karibu.
He should also know the roads of Mwanza and nearby towns.
Madereva watafanya kazi siku tano kwa wiki.
The drivers will work five days a week.
Kampuni italipa gharama za matibabu kwa mfanyakazi na familia yake.
The company will pay medical costs for the worker and his family.
Kila mwaka kutakuwa na likizo ya siku ishirini na nane.
Every year there will be a holiday of twenty-eight days.
Ukipenda kuomba, andika barua fupi na ueleze kazi uliyofanya zamani.
If you would like to apply, write a short letter and explain the work you did before.
Tuma barua pamoja na nakala ya leseni yako.
Send the letter together with a copy of your licence.
Mwisho wa kuomba ni tarehe thelathini mwezi huu.
The deadline for applying is the thirtieth of this month.
Watakaochaguliwa wataitwa kwa mahojiano mwezi ujao.
Those who are chosen will be called for an interview next month.

questions.en: How many drivers is the company looking for?

questions.q: Mtu asiye na uzoefu anaweza kuomba.
questions.en: A person with no experience can apply.

questions.q: Kampuni italipia matibabu ya familia ya mfanyakazi.
questions.en: The company will pay for the worker's family's medical care.

questions.q: Mtu anapaswa kutuma nini pamoja na barua?
questions.en: What should a person send with the letter?
Those chosen will be interviewed next month.

passages.title: Mafuriko mjini
sentences: Wiki hii mvua kubwa imenyesha kwa siku nne bila kusimama.
This week heavy rain has fallen for four days without stopping.
Mto mdogo unaopita katikati ya mji ulijaa maji.
The small river that goes through the middle of the town filled with water.
Jumatano usiku maji yaliingia katika nyumba nyingi za mtaa wa Jangwani.
On Wednesday night water entered many houses in Jangwani street.
Familia nyingi zililazimika kuondoka na kulala shuleni.
Many families had to leave and sleep at the school.
Serikali ilileta chakula, maji safi na nguo.
The government brought food, clean water and clothes.
Shule nyingi zilifungwa kwa sababu barabara zilijaa maji.
Many schools were closed because the roads were full of water.
Umeme ulikatika kwa siku mbili katika sehemu nyingi za mji.
Electricity was cut for two days in many parts of the town.
Vijana wengi walisaidia kuwabeba wazee na watoto.
Many young people helped to carry old people and children.
Leo mvua imepungua na jua limeanza kuonekana.
Today the rain has decreased and the sun has started to appear.
Hata hivyo, watu wanaambiwa wasinywe maji ya mto.
Even so, people are told not to drink river water.
Wataalam wanasema maji hayo yanaweza kuleta magonjwa.
Experts say that water can bring diseases.
Serikali inasema itajenga mfumo mpya wa kuondoa maji mwaka ujao.
The government says it will build a new drainage system next year.

questions.en: How long did the rain fall?
Several families slept at the school.
The electricity was not cut at all.
What are people told not to do?
The government will build a new system.

passages.title: Barua pepe kwa mwalimu
sentences: Habari za asubuhi, Mwalimu Magesa.
Good morning, Teacher Magesa.
Mimi ni mama wa Juma, mwanafunzi wa darasa la tano.
I am the mother of Juma, a pupil in class five.
Nakuandikia kukujulisha kwamba Juma hatakuja shuleni leo na kesho.
I am writing to let you know that Juma will not come to school today and tomorrow.
Tangu jana usiku ana homa na kichwa kinamuuma.
Since last night he has had a fever and a headache.
Tulikwenda kwa daktari asubuhi hii na amepewa dawa.
We went to the doctor this morning and he has been given medicine.
Daktari amesema anahitaji kukaa nyumbani kwa siku mbili.
The doctor has said he needs to stay at home for two days.
Najua kwamba wiki hii mna mtihani wa hesabu.
I know that this week you have a maths test.
Je, inawezekana Juma afanye mtihani huo wiki ijayo?
Is it possible for Juma to do that test next week?
Pia naomba umpe kaka yake kazi ya nyumbani ili asibaki nyuma.
Also I ask you to give the homework to his brother so that he does not fall behind.
Kaka yake yuko darasa la saba katika shule hiyo hiyo.
His brother is in class seven in the same school.
Asante sana kwa msaada wako.
Thank you very much for your help.
Wako, Mama Juma.
Yours, Mama Juma.

questions.en: Which class is Juma in?
Juma started feeling ill last night.

questions.q: Daktari amesema Juma anaweza kwenda shule leo.
questions.en: The doctor has said Juma can go to school today.
What does the mother ask about the test?

questions.q: Kaka wa Juma anasoma shule hiyo hiyo.
questions.en: Juma's brother studies at the same school.

passages.title: Kupanda mlima
sentences: Mwaka jana rafiki yangu Kevin na mimi tulipanda Mlima Kilimanjaro.
Last year my friend Kevin and I climbed Mount Kilimanjaro.
Tulianza safari kutoka mji wa Moshi pamoja na kiongozi na watu watatu wa kubeba mizigo.
We started the journey from the town of Moshi with a guide and three people to carry the luggage.
Siku ya kwanza tulitembea katika msitu mkubwa wenye miti mirefu.
On the first day we walked in a big forest with tall trees.
Tuliona wanyama wadogo na ndege wa rangi nyingi.
We saw small animals and birds of many colours.
Kila usiku tulilala katika hema na tulikula chakula cha moto.
Every night we slept in a tent and ate hot food.
Kadiri tulivyopanda juu, hewa ilikuwa baridi zaidi.
The higher we climbed, the colder the air became.
Siku ya tano tuliamka saa sita usiku kupanda sehemu ya mwisho.
On the fifth day we got up at midnight to climb the last part.
Ilikuwa kazi ngumu sana na Kevin alitaka kurudi nyuma.
It was very hard work and Kevin wanted to turn back.
Kiongozi wetu alimtia moyo na tukaendelea polepole.
Our guide encouraged him and we continued slowly.
Tulifika juu kabisa asubuhi na mapema.
We reached the very top early in the morning.
Tuliona theluji na nchi nzima chini yetu.
We saw snow and the whole country below us.
Nilihisi furaha kubwa ambayo sitaisahau.
I felt a great joy that I will not forget.

questions.en: Where did they start the journey from?

questions.q: Juu ya mlima kulikuwa na baridi zaidi.
questions.en: Higher on the mountain it was colder.

questions.q: Siku ya tano waliamka asubuhi saa mbili.
questions.en: On the fifth day they got up at eight in the morning.
What did Kevin want to do?
When they got to the top they saw snow.

passages.title: Kuhamia mji mpya
sentences: Mwezi uliopita familia ya Sara ilihamia Dodoma kutoka Arusha.
Last month Sara's family moved to Dodoma from Arusha.
Baba yake alipata kazi mpya katika wizara moja ya serikali.
Her father got a new job in a government ministry.
Mwanzoni Sara hakufurahi kwa sababu aliwaacha rafiki zake wote.
At first Sara was not happy because she left all her friends.
Pia hali ya hewa ni tofauti; Dodoma ni kavu na kuna upepo mwingi.
The weather is also different; Dodoma is dry and there is a lot of wind.
Nyumba yao mpya ni ndogo kuliko ile ya zamani, lakini ina bustani nzuri.
Their new house is smaller than the old one, but it has a nice garden.
Sara alianza shule mpya wiki iliyopita.
Sara started a new school last week.
Siku ya kwanza aliogopa na hakuzungumza na mtu yeyote.
On the first day she was afraid and did not talk to anyone.
Siku ya pili msichana mmoja anayeitwa Rehema alikaa karibu naye.
On the second day a girl called Rehema sat next to her.
Walianza kuzungumza na kugundua kwamba wote wanapenda kuchora.
They began to talk and discovered that they both like drawing.
Sasa wanarudi nyumbani pamoja kila siku.
Now they walk home together every day.
Sara bado anawasiliana na rafiki zake wa Arusha kwa simu.
Sara still keeps in touch with her Arusha friends by phone.
Anasema maisha mapya si mabaya kama alivyofikiri.
She says the new life is not as bad as she thought.

questions.q: Familia ilihamia Dodoma kwa sababu ya kazi ya baba.
questions.en: The family moved to Dodoma because of the father's job.

questions.q: Hali ya hewa ya Dodoma ni ya aina gani?
questions.en: What kind of weather does Dodoma have?

questions.q: Nyumba mpya ni kubwa kuliko ya zamani.
questions.en: The new house is bigger than the old one.

questions.q: Sara na Rehema wanapenda kufanya nini?
questions.en: What do Sara and Rehema like doing?

questions.q: Sara bado anaongea na rafiki zake wa zamani.
questions.en: Sara still talks with her old friends.

passages.title: Uamuzi mgumu

oop.muuguzi: nurse, everyday job word the frequency ranking leaves out

sentences: Salma amefanya kazi kama muuguzi katika hospitali ya Mombasa kwa miaka minane.
Salma has worked as a nurse in a Mombasa hospital for eight years.
Mwezi uliopita alipata barua kutoka kwa hospitali moja kubwa ya Dubai.
Last month she received a letter from a big hospital in Dubai.
Wanampa kazi yenye mshahara mara tatu zaidi ya anaopata sasa.
They are offering her a job with a salary three times more than she gets now.
Mwanzoni alifurahi sana, lakini baadaye alianza kufikiri kwa makini.
At first she was very happy, but later she began to think carefully.
Mama yake ni mzee na anaishi peke yake karibu na Salma.
Her mother is old and lives alone near Salma.
Kila jioni Salma humpikia chakula na kumsaidia kazi za nyumbani.
Every evening Salma cooks for her and helps her with housework.
Kaka zake wanaishi mbali na hawawezi kumtunza mama yao kila siku.
Her brothers live far away and cannot look after their mother every day.
Kwa upande mwingine, pesa za ziada zingemsaidia kulipa ada ya shule ya watoto wake.
On the other hand, the extra money would help her pay her children's school fees.
Pia angepata uzoefu mpya ambao ungemsaidia kupata cheo cha juu baadaye.
She would also gain new experience that would help her get a higher position later.
Salma alizungumza na mama yake kuhusu jambo hilo.
Salma talked with her mother about the matter.
Mama alimwambia asikatae nafasi hiyo kwa sababu yake.
Her mother told her not to refuse the opportunity because of her.
Hata hivyo, Salma bado hajaamua.
Even so, Salma has not yet decided.
Anapaswa kutoa jibu kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi huu.
She must give an answer before the end of this month.

questions.q: Salma amekuwa muuguzi kwa zaidi ya miaka mitano.
questions.en: Salma has been a nurse for more than five years.

questions.q: Mshahara wa kazi mpya ungekuwa vipi?
questions.en: What would the new job's salary be like?

questions.q: Kaka wa Salma wanamtunza mama yao kila siku.
questions.en: Salma's brothers look after their mother every day.

questions.q: Pesa za ziada zingemsaidia Salma kufanya nini?
questions.en: What would the extra money help Salma do?

questions.q: Mama anataka Salma afikirie kazi hiyo bila kujali hali yake.
questions.en: The mother wants Salma to consider the job without worrying about her.

passages.title: Malalamiko kwa hoteli

oop.kiyoyozi: air conditioner, hotel-room word with no pack equivalent
oop.meneja: manager, everyday loanword the frequency ranking leaves out

sentences: Kwa meneja wa hoteli,
To the hotel manager,
Naandika kueleza masikitiko yangu kuhusu huduma niliyopata katika hoteli yenu wiki iliyopita.
I am writing to express my disappointment about the service I received at your hotel last week.
Nilikaa hapo kwa usiku tatu pamoja na mume wangu na watoto wawili.
I stayed there for three nights with my husband and two children.
Kwenye tovuti yenu mliandika kwamba vyumba vyote vina kiyoyozi na maji ya moto.
On your website you wrote that all rooms have air conditioning and hot water.
Hata hivyo, katika chumba chetu maji ya moto hayakupatikana hata siku moja.
However, in our room there was no hot water on a single day.
Tulimweleza mhudumu mara mbili, lakini hakuna aliyekuja kurekebisha tatizo.
We told the attendant twice, but nobody came to fix the problem.
Pia chakula cha asubuhi kilikuwa baridi na kilichelewa kila siku.
Also breakfast was cold and was late every day.
Siku ya mwisho tuliambiwa kulipa gharama ya ziada ambayo hatukuelezwa mwanzoni.
On the last day we were told to pay an extra charge that had not been explained to us at the start.
Nilipouliza, meneja msaidizi alinijibu vibaya mbele ya watoto wangu.
When I asked, the assistant manager answered me rudely in front of my children.
Kwa kawaida napenda kutembelea Bagamoyo na nilitarajia likizo nzuri.
Usually I like visiting Bagamoyo and I expected a good holiday.
Naomba mrudishe gharama ya ziada tuliyolipa.
I request that you refund the extra charge we paid.
Pia natumaini mtawafundisha wafanyakazi wenu kuwaheshimu wateja.
I also hope you will teach your staff to respect customers.
Wako, Jamila.
Yours, Jamila.

questions.en: Jamila stayed at the hotel alone.

questions.q: Tatizo la kwanza la chumba lilikuwa nini?
questions.en: What was the room's first problem?

questions.q: Chakula cha asubuhi hakikuja kwa wakati.
questions.en: Breakfast did not come on time.
When Jamila asked, how was she answered?

questions.q: Jamila anataka arudishiwe pesa za ziada.
questions.en: Jamila wants the extra money returned to her.

passages.title: Kiwanda kitafungwa

oop.saruji: cement, the factory's product, no pack word
oop.fidia: compensation, the union's demand, no pack word

sentences: Kampuni inayomiliki kiwanda cha saruji cha Tanga imetangaza kwamba kiwanda hicho kitafungwa mwezi Juni.
The company that owns the Tanga cement factory has announced that the factory will close in June.
Kiwanda hicho kimekuwa kikifanya kazi kwa zaidi ya miaka arobaini.
The factory has been operating for more than forty years.
Kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya kampuni, gharama za umeme zimepanda sana katika miaka ya karibuni.
According to the company's statement, electricity costs have risen sharply in recent years.
Pia mashine nyingi ni za zamani na zinahitaji kubadilishwa.
Also many machines are old and need to be replaced.
Zaidi ya wafanyakazi mia tano watapoteza kazi zao.
More than five hundred workers will lose their jobs.
Wengi wao wameishi karibu na kiwanda maisha yao yote.
Many of them have lived near the factory all their lives.
Viongozi wa chama cha wafanyakazi wamesema watakutana na serikali wiki ijayo.
Leaders of the workers' union have said they will meet the government next week.
Wanataka kampuni iwalipe wafanyakazi fidia ya kutosha.
They want the company to pay the workers enough compensation.
Wafanyabiashara wa mji pia wana wasiwasi.
The town's traders are also worried.
Mama mmoja anayeuza chakula karibu na lango la kiwanda alisema biashara yake itaathirika.
A woman who sells food near the factory gate said her business will be affected.
Serikali imeahidi kutafuta kampuni nyingine ya kununua kiwanda.
The government has promised to look for another company to buy the factory.
Hata hivyo, wakazi wengi hawana matumaini makubwa.
However, many residents do not have great hope.

questions.en: When will the factory close?

questions.q: Moja ya sababu ni bei ya umeme.
questions.en: One of the reasons is the price of electricity.
Only a few workers will be affected.
What does the workers' union want?

questions.q: Serikali itatafuta kampuni ya kununua kiwanda.
questions.en: The government will look for a buyer for the factory.

passages.title: Utalii na mazingira
sentences: Kila mwaka maelfu ya watalii hutembelea mbuga ya Serengeti kuona wanyama.
Every year thousands of tourists visit Serengeti park to see the animals.
Utalii huleta fedha nyingi kwa nchi na kutoa ajira kwa vijana.
Tourism brings a lot of money to the country and provides employment for young people.
Madereva, wafanyakazi wa hoteli na watu wanaouza zawadi wote hunufaika.
Drivers, hotel workers and people who sell souvenirs all benefit.
Hata hivyo, wataalam wa mazingira wanasema kuna hatari pia.
However, environmental experts say there is also a danger.
Magari mengi yanayoingia mbugani husababisha vumbi na kelele zinazowasumbua wanyama.
The many vehicles that enter the park cause dust and noise that disturb the animals.
Wakati mwingine magari huzunguka simba mmoja kwa saa nzima ili watalii wapige picha.
Sometimes vehicles surround one lion for a whole hour so that tourists can take photos.
Pia hoteli mpya zinajengwa karibu na njia ambazo wanyama hutumia kila mwaka.
Also new hotels are being built near the routes that animals use every year.
Wataalam wanapendekeza idadi ya magari ipunguzwe katika maeneo fulani.
The experts suggest that the number of vehicles be reduced in certain areas.
Wanasema pia sehemu ya pesa za utalii itumike kuwasaidia wakazi wanaoishi karibu na mbuga.
They also say part of the tourism money should be used to help residents living near the park.
Kwa njia hii, wananchi wataona faida ya kulinda wanyama.
In this way, local people will see the benefit of protecting animals.
Serikali imesema itajadili mapendekezo hayo mwaka huu.
The government has said it will discuss those proposals this year.
Swali kubwa ni jinsi ya kupata usawa kati ya uchumi na mazingira.
The big question is how to find a balance between the economy and the environment.

questions.en: Tourism gives young people jobs.
What do the experts say the vehicles cause?

questions.q: Hoteli mpya zinajengwa mbali na njia za wanyama.
questions.en: New hotels are being built far from the animals' routes.

questions.q: Wataalam wanataka pesa za utalii zisaidie nani?
questions.en: Who do the experts want the tourism money to help?
The government will discuss the proposals this year.

passages.title: Maktaba ya kijiji
sentences: Miaka mitatu iliyopita kijiji chetu hakikuwa na maktaba hata moja.
Three years ago our village did not have a single library.
Wanafunzi walilazimika kusafiri kilometa ishirini hadi mjini ili kusoma vitabu.
Pupils had to travel twenty kilometres to town in order to read books.
Mwalimu mstaafu anayeitwa Mwanaidi aliamua kubadilisha hali hiyo.
A retired teacher called Mwanaidi decided to change that situation.
Alianza kwa kukusanya vitabu vya zamani kutoka kwa marafiki na familia yake.
She started by collecting old books from friends and her family.
Kisha aliomba msaada kutoka kwa shirika moja la kimataifa.
Then she asked for help from an international organisation.
Watu wa kijiji walichangia fedha na nguvu zao kujenga jengo dogo karibu na shule.
The villagers contributed money and their labour to build a small building near the school.
Leo maktaba ina zaidi ya vitabu elfu mbili na kompyuta nne.
Today the library has more than two thousand books and four computers.
Inafunguliwa kila siku, lakini si Jumapili.
It is open every day except Sunday.
Watoto huja baada ya shule kufanya kazi za nyumbani na kusoma hadithi.
Children come after school to do homework and read stories.
Watu wazima pia hutumia kompyuta kutafuta habari za kilimo na afya.
Adults also use the computers to look for information on farming and health.
Mwanaidi anasema matokeo ya mitihani ya shule yamekuwa bora zaidi tangu maktaba ifunguliwe.
Mwanaidi says the school's exam results have become better since the library opened.
Sasa anatafuta watu wa kusaidia kufundisha wazee kusoma na kuandika.
Now she is looking for volunteers to teach older people to read and write.

questions.en: In the past pupils read books in the village.
What did Mwanaidi begin by doing?

questions.q: Watu wa kijiji walisaidia kujenga maktaba.
questions.en: The villagers helped build the library.

questions.q: Watu wazima hutumia kompyuta kwa ajili ya nini?
questions.en: What do adults use the computers for?

questions.q: Matokeo ya mitihani ni bora sasa.
questions.en: Exam results are better now.

passages.title: Mafuriko mtaani
sentences: Mwezi uliopita mvua kubwa ilinyesha Morogoro kwa siku nne bila kusimama.
Last month heavy rain fell in Morogoro for four days without stopping.
Mto mmoja karibu na mtaa wetu ulijaa, na maji yakaingia katika nyumba nyingi.
A river near our street filled up, and water entered many houses.
Familia ya Hamisi ilipoteza vitanda, nguo na chakula chote kilichokuwa ndani.
Hamisi's family lost their beds, clothes and all the food that was inside.
Watoto wao walilala kwa majirani kwa wiki mbili.
Their children slept at the neighbours' for two weeks.
Shule ya msingi ilifungwa kwa sababu madarasa yalijaa maji machafu.
The primary school was closed because the classrooms were full of dirty water.
Vijana wa mtaa walisaidia kutoa maji ndani ya nyumba na kusafisha barabara.
The young people of the street helped get the water out of the houses and clean the roads.
Waumini wa msikiti na wa kanisa walikusanya chakula na nguo kwa familia zilizopata hasara.
Worshippers from the mosque and the church collected food and clothes for the families that suffered losses.
Serikali imeahidi kujenga daraja jipya na kusafisha mto.
The government has promised to build a new bridge and clean the river.
Hata hivyo, wazee wanasema watu wengi wamejenga nyumba karibu sana na mto.
However, the elders say many people have built houses too close to the river.
Zamani eneo hilo lilikuwa shamba, na hakuna mtu aliyeishi pale.
In the past that area was farmland, and nobody lived there.
Wanashauri kila familia ijiandae mapema kabla ya msimu ujao wa mvua.
They advise every family to prepare early before the next rainy season.
Hamisi sasa anapanga kuhamia sehemu ya juu zaidi.
Hamisi now plans to move to higher ground.

questions.q: Mvua ilinyesha kwa siku moja tu.
questions.en: The rain fell for only one day.
What did Hamisi's family lose?
Why was the school closed?

questions.q: Watu wa dini tofauti waliwasaidia wenzao.
questions.en: People of different faiths helped their fellows.
What problem do the elders see?

passages.title: Mwezi wa Ramadhani
sentences: Kila mwaka familia ya Zuhura hufunga mwezi mzima wa Ramadhani.
Every year Zuhura's family fasts the whole month of Ramadan.
Wanaamka kabla ya alfajiri na kula chakula kidogo pamoja.
They wake before dawn and eat a little food together.
Mchana watu wazima hawali wala hawanywi chochote hadi jua linapozama.
During the day adults neither eat nor drink anything until the sun sets.
Watoto wadogo, wazee dhaifu na wagonjwa hawalazimiki kufunga.
Small children, frail old people and the sick are not obliged to fast.
Jioni Zuhura humsaidia mama yake kupika chai, mikate na matunda.
In the evening Zuhura helps her mother prepare tea, bread and fruit.
Jua linapozama, familia yote hukaa pamoja na kula kwa utulivu.
When the sun sets, the whole family sits together and eats calmly.
Mara nyingi wanapeleka chakula kwa majirani na kwa wazee wasio na msaada.
They often take food to neighbours and to old people who have no help.
Baba yake husema mwezi huu unafundisha uvumilivu na kuwajali maskini.
Her father says this month teaches patience and caring for the poor.
Usiku watu wengi huenda msikitini pamoja.
At night many people go to the mosque together.
Mwisho wa mwezi, familia husherehekea Idi kwa kuvaa nguo mpya na kutembeleana.
At the end of the month the family celebrates Eid by wearing new clothes and visiting one another.
Watoto hupewa zawadi ndogo, na kila nyumba ina furaha.
Children are given small gifts, and every home is happy.
Zuhura anaipenda sherehe hii kwa sababu ndugu wote hukutana.
Zuhura loves this celebration because all the relatives meet.

questions.q: Kila mtu katika familia lazima afunge, hata watoto wadogo.
questions.en: Everyone in the family must fast, even small children.
What does Zuhura do in the evening?

questions.q: Familia hufanya nini na chakula mara nyingi?
questions.en: What does the family often do with food?

questions.q: Baba anasema mwezi huu unafundisha nini?
questions.en: What does the father say this month teaches?

questions.q: Katika sherehe hii ndugu wa Zuhura huonana.
questions.en: At this celebration Zuhura's relatives see one another.

passages.title: Bei sokoni
sentences: Neema huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi kununua chakula cha wiki nzima.
Neema goes to the market every Saturday to buy food for the whole week.
Siku hizi anarudi nyumbani na vitu vichache kuliko zamani.
These days she returns home with fewer things than before.
Mwaka jana alinunua sukari kwa bei nafuu, lakini sasa bei imepanda mara mbili.
Last year she bought sugar at a low price, but now the price has doubled.
Mafuta ya kupikia na mahindi pia yamekuwa ghali.
Cooking oil and maize have also become expensive.
Wafanyabiashara wanasema wao pia wanalipa zaidi kwa usafiri kwa sababu mafuta ya magari yamepanda.
Traders say they too pay more for transport because fuel for vehicles has gone up.
Mvua kidogo mwaka huu imepunguza mazao katika mashamba mengi.
Little rain this year has reduced the crops on many farms.
Kwa hiyo chakula kinachofika sokoni ni kidogo, na bei inazidi kupanda.
So the food that reaches the market is little, and the price keeps rising.
Ili kuokoa pesa, Neema ameanza kupanda mboga katika bustani ndogo nyuma ya nyumba.
To save money, Neema has started planting vegetables in a small garden behind the house.
Pia ananunua pamoja na majirani zake kwa wingi, kisha wanagawa vitu hivyo.
She also buys in bulk together with her neighbours, then they share the goods.
Kwa njia hii wanapata bei nzuri zaidi kutoka kwa wakulima.
In this way they get a better price from the farmers.
Hadi sasa familia yake inakula nyama mara moja tu kwa wiki.
For now her family eats meat only once a week.
Neema anatumaini kwamba bei zitashuka baada ya mvua za mwaka ujao.
Neema hopes that prices will come down after next year's rains.

questions.q: Neema sasa hununua vitu vingi zaidi kuliko zamani.
questions.en: Neema now buys more things than before.
Why have the traders raised prices?

questions.q: Neema amefanya nini ili kuokoa pesa?
questions.en: What has Neema done to save money?

questions.q: Neema hununua chakula pamoja na majirani.
questions.en: Neema buys food together with neighbours.

questions.q: Familia ya Neema inakula nyama mara ngapi?
questions.en: How often does Neema's family eat meat?

passages.title: Biashara ya chakula
sentences: Rehema alimaliza masomo ya kupika katika chuo kimoja miaka miwili iliyopita.
Rehema finished cookery studies at a college two years ago.
Alijifunza kupika vizuri, lakini hakupata kazi katika hoteli za Mwanza.
She learned to cook well, but she did not find a job in the hotels of Mwanza.
Kwa hiyo aliamua kuanza biashara yake mwenyewe karibu na kiwanda kimoja.
So she decided to start her own business near a factory.
Alipata mkopo mdogo kutoka kikundi cha akina mama cha mtaa wake.
She got a small loan from her street's women's group.
Kwa pesa hizo alinunua vyombo vya jikoni, meza na viti vichache.
With that money she bought kitchen utensils, a table and a few chairs.
Mwanzoni wateja walikuwa wachache, hasa wafanyakazi wa kiwanda.
At first customers were few, mostly factory workers.
Alipika wali, ugali na mboga kwa bei nafuu, na wateja wakaanza kuwaambia wengine.
She cooked rice, ugali and vegetables at a low price, and customers began telling others.
Sasa anauza chakula kwa watu zaidi ya hamsini kila siku.
Now she sells food to more than fifty people every day.
Ana wasichana wawili ambao anawafundisha kazi hii.
She has two girls whom she is teaching this work.
Kila mwezi analipa sehemu ya mkopo, na amebakiza miezi mitatu tu.
Every month she pays part of the loan, and she has only three months left.
Changamoto kubwa ni mvua, kwa sababu wateja hawakai nje wakati wa mvua.
The big challenge is rain, because customers do not sit outside when it rains.
Rehema anapanga kujenga paa na kufungua mgahawa mdogo mwaka ujao.
Rehema plans to build a roof and open a small restaurant next year.

questions.q: Rehema alipata kazi hotelini baada ya chuo.
questions.en: Rehema got a hotel job after college.

questions.q: Rehema alipata wapi pesa za kuanza biashara?
questions.en: Where did Rehema get the money to start the business?
options: Kutoka kwa benki kubwa ya mjini

questions.q: Rehema aliuza chakula chake kwa bei gani?
questions.en: At what price did Rehema sell her food?
options: Bei ghali kuliko hoteli za mjini

questions.q: Wakati wa mvua, Rehema hupata wateja wachache.
questions.en: When it rains, Rehema gets few customers.
What does Rehema plan to do?

passages.title: Pesa kwa simu
sentences: Juma anafanya kazi Dodoma, lakini wazazi wake wanaishi kijijini.
Juma works in Dodoma, but his parents live in the village.
Zamani alituma pesa kupitia kwa dereva wa gari la abiria aliyemfahamu.
In the past he sent money through a driver of a passenger vehicle he knew.
Mara moja pesa zilipotea njiani na hakuna aliyejua zilikwenda wapi.
Once the money was lost on the way and nobody knew where it went.
Siku hizi anatumia simu yake kutuma pesa.
These days he uses his phone to send money.
Anaandika nambari ya simu ya baba yake, kiasi cha pesa na nambari yake ya siri.
He types his father's phone number, the amount of money and his secret number.
Baada ya dakika moja baba yake anapata ujumbe kwamba pesa zimefika.
After one minute his father gets a message that the money has arrived.
Baba anaweza kuzitoa kwenye duka dogo karibu na soko la kijiji.
His father can withdraw it at a small shop near the village market.
Juma analipa gharama ndogo kwa kila huduma.
Juma pays a small fee for each service.
Anasema njia hii ni rahisi, salama na ya haraka.
He says this way is easy, safe and fast.
Wiki iliyopita mtu mmoja alimpigia baba simu akisema ni mfanyakazi wa kampuni ya simu.
Last week a man phoned his father saying he was an employee of the phone company.
Aliomba nambari ya siri, lakini baba alikataa na akamjulisha Juma mara moja.
He asked for the secret number, but his father refused and told Juma at once.
Juma alifurahi, na akawaambia ndugu wengine wawe makini pia.
Juma was pleased, and he told other relatives to be careful too.

questions.q: Kulitokea nini mara moja pesa zilipotumwa kupitia kwa dereva?
questions.en: What happened once when money was sent through a driver?

questions.q: Baba hujua pesa zimefika kwa sababu anapata ujumbe.
questions.en: The father knows the money has arrived because he gets a message.

questions.q: Huduma ya kutuma pesa kwa simu haina gharama yoyote.
questions.en: The service of sending money by phone has no cost at all.

questions.q: Baba alifanya nini mtu alipoomba nambari ya siri?
questions.en: What did the father do when the man asked for the secret number?

passages.title: Siku hospitalini
sentences: Asubuhi ya leo Aisha alimpeleka mtoto wake wa miezi tisa kwenye hospitali ndogo ya kijiji.
This morning Aisha took her nine-month-old child to the small village hospital.
Daktari alimpima mtoto na kuandika matokeo kwenye kadi yake.
The doctor measured the child and wrote the result on his card.
Kisha mtoto alipewa dawa ya kinga dhidi ya ugonjwa hatari wa watoto.
Then the child was given a protective medicine against a dangerous childhood disease.
Mtoto alilia kidogo, lakini baada ya dakika chache alinyamaza.
The child cried a little, but after a few minutes he became quiet.
Daktari alimweleza Aisha kwamba huenda mtoto atapata homa kidogo usiku.
The doctor explained to Aisha that the child might get a slight fever at night.
Alimshauri ampe mtoto maji ya kutosha na amwangalie kwa karibu.
He advised her to give the child enough water and to watch him closely.
Aisha aliambiwa arudi baada ya miezi mitatu kwa kinga nyingine.
Aisha was told to come back after three months for another protective dose.
Ukutani kulikuwa na picha zinazoeleza umuhimu wa kusafisha mikono kabla ya kula.
On the wall there were pictures explaining the importance of cleaning hands before eating.
Pia kulikuwa na ushauri kuhusu chakula bora kwa watoto wadogo.
There was also advice about good food for small children.
Aisha anafurahi kwa sababu huduma hii ni bure kwa watoto wote.
Aisha is happy because this service is free for all children.
Anawaambia majirani zake wasikose kuwapeleka watoto wao.
She tells her neighbours not to miss taking their children.
Anaamini kwamba watoto wenye afya ni furaha ya familia nzima.
She believes that healthy children are the joy of the whole family.

questions.en: What did the doctor do first?

questions.q: Mtoto alilia siku nzima baada ya kupewa dawa.
questions.en: The child cried all day after being given the medicine.
When will Aisha return to the hospital?

questions.q: Aisha hakulipa pesa kwa huduma hii.
questions.en: Aisha did not pay money for this service.

passages.title: Mkutano wa wazazi
sentences: Jumamosi iliyopita shule ya Bakari ilifanya mkutano wa wazazi.
Last Saturday Bakari's school held a parents' meeting.
Mwalimu mkuu alieleza kwamba matokeo ya mtihani yameshuka mwaka huu.
The head teacher explained that exam results have dropped this year.
Alisema wanafunzi wengi hufika shuleni wakiwa wamechoka na wana njaa.
He said many students arrive at school tired and hungry.
Baadhi yao hutembea zaidi ya saa moja kila asubuhi.
Some of them walk more than an hour every morning.
Wengine hawali chochote kabla ya kuondoka nyumbani.
Others eat nothing before leaving home.
Wazazi walijadili njia za kuwasaidia watoto wao.
The parents discussed ways to help their children.
Mariamu, mama wa Bakari, alipendekeza shule iandae chai na mkate kila asubuhi.
Mariamu, Bakari's mother, suggested that the school prepare tea and bread every morning.
Kila familia itachangia kiasi kidogo cha pesa na sukari kila mwezi.
Every family will contribute a small amount of money and sugar each month.
Baba mmoja alisema anaweza kutoa mahindi kutoka shamba lake.
One father said he can give maize from his farm.
Walimu waliahidi kuwapa wanafunzi masomo ya ziada jioni.
The teachers promised to give the students extra lessons in the evening.
Mwalimu mkuu aliwashukuru wazazi kwa mawazo yao mazuri.
The head teacher thanked the parents for their good ideas.
Mwisho wa mkutano, wazazi walichagua kamati ya watu watano kufuatilia mpango huu.
At the end of the meeting, the parents chose a committee of five people to follow up this plan.

questions.q: Mwalimu mkuu alieleza tatizo gani la wanafunzi?
questions.en: What problem of the students did the head teacher explain?

questions.q: Wazo la kuwapa wanafunzi chai asubuhi lilitoka kwa Mariamu.
questions.en: The idea of giving students tea in the morning came from Mariamu.
What did one father say he would give?

questions.q: Mwalimu mkuu peke yake atasimamia mpango huu.
questions.en: The head teacher alone will manage this plan.

passages.title: Kwa bibi Arusha
sentences: Wakati wa likizo ya shule, Fatuma alisafiri kwenda Arusha kumtembelea bibi yake.
During the school holiday, Fatuma travelled to Arusha to visit her grandmother.
Gari la abiria liliondoka Tanga alfajiri na mapema.
The passenger vehicle left Tanga very early at dawn.
Safari ilichukua karibu saa tisa kwa sababu barabara ilikuwa ikitengenezwa.
The journey took about nine hours because the road was being repaired.
Njiani gari lilisimama mara mbili ili abiria wanunue chakula na kupumzika.
On the way the vehicle stopped twice so passengers could buy food and rest.
Fatuma aliketi karibu na mwanamke mzee aliyekuwa akienda hospitali.
Fatuma sat next to an old woman who was going to hospital.
Walizungumza kuhusu familia zao na maisha ya kijijini.
They talked about their families and village life.
Walipofika, bibi yake alikuwa akimsubiri kituoni pamoja na mjomba wake.
When they arrived, her grandmother was waiting for her at the station with her uncle.
Bibi anaishi katika nyumba ndogo yenye shamba la ndizi na kahawa.
Grandmother lives in a small house with a banana and coffee farm.
Kwa wiki mbili Fatuma alimsaidia kukusanya kahawa na kuleta maji.
For two weeks Fatuma helped her gather coffee and bring water.
Mjomba alimwonyesha jinsi ya kutunza ng'ombe.
Her uncle showed her how to look after cows.
Jioni bibi alimsimulia hadithi za zamani karibu na moto.
In the evenings grandmother told her old stories by the fire.
Hewa ya Arusha ilikuwa baridi kuliko ya Tanga.
The air in Arusha was colder than in Tanga.
Fatuma alirudi nyumbani akiwa amejifunza mambo mengi mapya.
Fatuma returned home having learned many new things.

questions.q: Kwa nini safari ilichukua muda mrefu?
questions.en: Why did the journey take a long time?

questions.q: Fatuma aliketi karibu na mtoto mdogo.
questions.en: Fatuma sat next to a small child.
Who waited for Fatuma at the station?
options: Mama yake na dada zake wote

questions.q: Fatuma alifanya kazi shambani kwa bibi yake.
questions.en: Fatuma worked on the farm at her grandmother's.
What did grandmother do in the evenings?
options: Alipika chakula kwa ajili ya majirani

passages.title: Maji ya mvua
sentences: Katika kijiji cha Kassimu karibu na Singida, maji ni tatizo kubwa wakati wa kiangazi.
In Kassimu's village near Singida, water is a big problem in the dry season.
Bomba la kijiji liko mbali, na wanawake hutembea saa mbili kila siku kuleta maji.
The village pump is far, and women walk two hours every day to bring water.
Mwaka jana kikundi cha vijana kilianzisha mradi wa kukusanya maji ya mvua.
Last year a youth group started a project to collect rainwater.
Waliweka vyombo vikubwa vya plastiki kando ya nyumba ili kupokea maji kutoka kwenye paa.
They put large plastic containers beside the houses to receive water from the roofs.
Kila familia inachangia kidogo kila mwezi ili kununua chombo chake.
Each family contributes a little every month to buy its container.
Sasa familia nyingi zina maji ya kutosha kwa miezi mitatu baada ya mvua.
Now many families have enough water for three months after the rains.
Wasichana wana muda zaidi wa kusoma kwa sababu hawaendi kwenye bomba kila siku.
Girls have more time to study because they do not go to the pump every day.
Hata hivyo, maji ya mvua lazima yapashwe moto kabla ya kunywa.
However, rainwater must be heated before drinking.
Watu pia wamejifunza kufunika vyombo vyao ili wadudu wasiingie.
People have also learned to cover their containers so insects do not get in.
Kassimu anatumaini kwamba shule na hospitali ya kijiji pia zitapata vyombo hivi.
Kassimu hopes that the school and the village hospital will also get these containers.
Anasema maji safi ni msingi wa afya na elimu.
He says clean water is the foundation of health and education.

questions.q: Wanawake hutumia muda mrefu kila siku kutafuta maji.
questions.en: Women spend a long time every day looking for water.
Who started this project?

questions.q: Mradi huu umewasaidia wasichana kwa njia gani?
questions.en: In what way has this project helped the girls?

questions.q: Maji ya mvua yanaweza kunywewa bila kupashwa moto.
questions.en: Rainwater can be drunk without being heated.

questions.q: Kwa nini watu hufunika vyombo vyao?
questions.en: Why do people cover their containers?

passages.title: Siku ya kupanda miti
sentences: Kila mwaka mwezi wa nne shule ya Halima huandaa siku ya kupanda miti.
Every year in the fourth month Halima's school organises a tree-planting day.
Mwaka huu wanafunzi walipanda miti mia tatu kuzunguka uwanja wa shule.
This year the students planted three hundred trees around the school grounds.
Mwalimu wa sayansi alieleza kwa nini miti ni muhimu kwa maisha.
The science teacher explained why trees are important for life.
Alisema mizizi ya miti inashika ardhi ili isichukuliwe na maji ya mvua.
He said tree roots hold the ground so that it is not carried away by rainwater.
Pia miti inatoa kivuli, matunda na hewa safi.
Trees also give shade, fruit and clean air.
Kila darasa lilipewa jukumu la kutunza miti yake.
Each class was given the duty of caring for its trees.
Wakati wa kiangazi wanafunzi watamwagia miti maji mara mbili kwa wiki.
In the dry season the students will pour water on the trees twice a week.
Halima na rafiki zake walipanda miti mitano ya maembe karibu na darasa lao.
Halima and her friends planted five mango trees near their classroom.
Wanatumaini kwamba siku moja wanafunzi wengine watakula maembe hayo.
They hope that one day other students will eat those mangoes.
Wazazi kadhaa walileta chakula na maji ya kunywa kwa wanafunzi.
Several parents brought food and drinking water for the students.
Mwisho wa siku, mkuu wa kijiji aliwashukuru na kuahidi kuleta miti zaidi.
At the end of the day, the village head thanked them and promised to bring more trees.
Halima anasema hii ni siku anayoipenda kuliko zote shuleni.
Halima says this is the day she likes most of all at school.

questions.q: Wanafunzi walipanda miti mingapi mwaka huu?
questions.en: How many trees did the students plant this year?

questions.q: Mwalimu alisema miti inalinda ardhi wakati wa mvua.
questions.en: The teacher said trees protect the ground when it rains.
What task does each class have?

questions.q: Halima alipanda miti ya ndizi karibu na darasa.
questions.en: Halima planted banana trees near the classroom.
What did the village head promise?

passages.title: Mahojiano ya kazi
sentences: Omari alimaliza chuo kikuu mwaka jana akiwa amesomea biashara.
Omari finished university last year having studied business.
Kwa miezi sita alituma barua nyingi za kuomba kazi bila kupata jibu.
For six months he sent many job application letters without getting a reply.
Wiki iliyopita hatimaye alipigiwa simu na kampuni moja ya usafiri.
Last week he was finally called by a transport company.
Aliambiwa afike ofisini kwao Jumatatu saa tatu asubuhi kwa mahojiano.
He was told to come to their office on Monday at nine in the morning for an interview.
Usiku wa kabla ya siku hiyo aliandaa nguo safi na nakala za vyeti vyake.
The night before that day he prepared clean clothes and copies of his certificates.
Asubuhi alivaa shati jeupe na viatu safi.
In the morning he wore a white shirt and clean shoes.
Alifika dakika ishirini mapema ili asichelewe.
He arrived twenty minutes early so as not to be late.
Watu watatu walimuuliza maswali kuhusu masomo yake na uzoefu wake.
Three people asked him questions about his studies and his experience.
Walitaka kujua kama anaweza kutumia kompyuta na kuzungumza Kiingereza.
They wanted to know whether he can use a computer and speak English.
Omari alijibu kwa utulivu na kueleza jinsi alivyosaidia biashara ya mjomba wake.
Omari answered calmly and explained how he had helped his uncle's business.
Baada ya siku tatu, kampuni ilimjulisha kwamba amepata kazi.
After three days, the company informed him that he had got the job.
Ataanza mwezi ujao, na mshahara wake wa kwanza atampa mama yake.
He will start next month, and he will give his first salary to his mother.

questions.en: Many companies answered Omari quickly.
When did Omari arrive at the office?
options: Saa moja baada ya muda wake

questions.en: What did they want to know about Omari?

questions.q: Omari ana mpango wa kumpa mama yake mshahara wake wa kwanza.
questions.en: Omari plans to give his mother his first salary.

passages.title: Barua kwa mwalimu

oop.malaria: the illness in the doctor's diagnosis, a common loanword missing from the frequency list

sentences: Mpendwa Mwalimu Khadija,
Dear Teacher Khadija,
Naandika kukujulisha kwamba mwanangu Yusufu hataweza kuja shuleni wiki hii.
I am writing to let you know that my son Yusufu will not be able to come to school this week.
Tangu Jumapili amekuwa na homa kali na maumivu ya kichwa.
Since Sunday he has had a high fever and a headache.
Jana tulimpeleka hospitali, na daktari aligundua kwamba ana malaria.
Yesterday we took him to hospital, and the doctor found that he has malaria.
Amepewa dawa na ameshauriwa kupumzika nyumbani kwa siku tano.
He has been given medicine and advised to rest at home for five days.
Usiku hapati usingizi mzuri, na hataki kula chakula.
At night he does not sleep well, and he does not want to eat.
Tunampa maji mengi na chakula kidogo kama daktari alivyoshauri.
We give him plenty of water and a little food as the doctor advised.
Kwa kawaida Yusufu anapenda sana masomo yake na hachelewi shuleni.
Usually Yusufu loves his lessons very much and is never late for school.
Sasa ana wasiwasi kwa sababu mtihani wa sayansi unakaribia.
Now he is worried because the science exam is coming soon.
Naomba umpe jirani yetu Salma kazi za nyumbani za Yusufu, kwa sababu anasoma katika darasa lake.
Please give our neighbour Salma Yusufu's homework, because she studies in his class.
Tutahakikisha anazifanya kazi hizo akipata nafuu.
We will make sure he does that work when he feels better.
Nitakuletea barua ya daktari atakaporudi shuleni.
I will bring you the doctor's letter when he returns to school.
Asante kwa msaada wako.
Thank you for your help.
Wako, Rashidi, baba wa Yusufu.
Yours, Rashidi, Yusufu's father.

questions.q: Daktari aligundua Yusufu ana ugonjwa gani?

questions.en: The doctor said Yusufu should rest for two weeks.

questions.q: Kazi za nyumbani zitampata Yusufu kupitia kwa nani?
questions.en: Through whom will the homework reach Yusufu?

questions.q: Baba ataleta barua ya daktari baadaye.
questions.en: The father will bring the doctor's letter later.

passages.title: Mkulima wa kahawa
sentences: Emmanueli ni mkulima wa kahawa karibu na mlima Kilimanjaro.
Emmanueli is a coffee farmer near Mount Kilimanjaro.
Shamba lake lilianzishwa na babu yake miaka mingi iliyopita.
His farm was started by his grandfather many years ago.
Kahawa inahitaji mvua ya kutosha, ardhi nzuri na kazi nyingi ya mikono.
Coffee needs enough rain, good soil and a lot of work by hand.
Wakati wa mazao, familia nzima husaidia kukusanya matunda mekundu ya kahawa.
At harvest time the whole family helps gather the red coffee fruits.
Kisha kahawa inasafishwa na kuwekwa juani kwa siku kadhaa.
Then the coffee is cleaned and put in the sun for several days.
Baadaye inapelekwa kwenye chama cha wakulima wa kijiji.
Afterwards it is taken to the village farmers' association.
Chama hicho kinauza kahawa ya wakulima wote kwa kampuni za nje.
That association sells all the farmers' coffee to foreign companies.
Miaka iliyopita bei ilikuwa chini sana, na wakulima wengi waliacha kahawa.
In past years the price was very low, and many farmers gave up coffee.
Baadhi yao walianza kupanda mboga na ndizi badala yake.
Some of them started planting vegetables and bananas instead.
Emmanueli hakuacha, na sasa bei imepanda tena.
Emmanueli did not give up, and now the price has risen again.
Mwaka huu ameweza kujenga nyumba mpya na kununua ng'ombe wawili.
This year he has been able to build a new house and buy two cows.
Anasema siri ni kutunza miti vizuri na kuwa na uvumilivu.
He says the secret is to look after the trees well and to be patient.

passages.title: Maisha mjini
sentences: Miaka mitano iliyopita Idrisa aliondoka kijijini kwenda kutafuta maisha mjini Mwanza.
Five years ago Idrisa left the village to seek a living in Mwanza town.
Mwanzoni alikaa na binamu yake katika chumba kimoja kidogo.
At first he stayed with his cousin in one small room.
Siku za kwanza hakumjua mtu yeyote mwingine mjini.
In the first days he did not know anyone else in town.
Kazi ya kwanza aliyoipata ilikuwa kubeba mizigo sokoni.
The first job he got was carrying loads at the market.
Maisha ya mjini yalikuwa ghali kuliko alivyotarajia.
Town life was more expensive than he had expected.
Alilipa kodi ya nyumba, usafiri na chakula, na pesa kidogo tu zilibaki.
He paid rent, transport and food, and only a little money was left.
Hata hivyo, aliweka pesa kidogo benki kila wiki.
Even so, he put a little money in the bank every week.
Baada ya miaka mitatu alinunua pikipiki na kuanza kubeba abiria.
After three years he bought a motorbike and began carrying passengers.
Sasa anapata pesa za kutosha kuwasaidia wazazi wake na kulipa ada ya shule ya dada yake.
Now he earns enough money to help his parents and pay his sister's school fees.
Kila Ijumaa huwapigia simu wazazi wake na kuzungumza nao.
Every Friday he phones his parents and talks with them.
Idrisa anasema anakosa hewa safi na utulivu wa kijijini.
Idrisa says he misses the clean air and calm of the village.
Anapanga kurudi kijijini siku moja na kujenga nyumba karibu na wazazi wake.
He plans to return to the village one day and build a house near his parents.

passages.title: Usafi wa mtaa
sentences: Mtaa wetu ulikuwa na tatizo la takataka kwa muda mrefu.
Our street had a rubbish problem for a long time.
Watu walitupa takataka kando ya barabara na karibu na mto.
People threw rubbish beside the road and near the river.
Wakati wa mvua, harufu mbaya ilienea na watoto wengi walipata magonjwa.
In the rainy season a bad smell spread and many children fell ill.
Mzee Salehe, mwenyekiti wa mtaa, aliita mkutano wa watu wote wa mtaa.
Mzee Salehe, the street chairman, called a meeting of everyone on the street.
Waliamua kusafisha mtaa pamoja kila Jumamosi ya mwisho wa mwezi.
They decided to clean the street together on the last Saturday of every month.
Kila familia itachangia pesa kidogo kulipia gari la kubeba takataka.
Every family will contribute a little money to pay for a rubbish lorry.
Vijana walijitolea kusafisha mto na kuondoa chupa za plastiki.
The young people volunteered to clean the river and remove plastic bottles.
Pia waliweka mapipa ya takataka katika kila kona ya mtaa.
They also put rubbish drums on every corner of the street.
Atakayetupa takataka barabarani atalazimika kulipa faini.
Anyone who throws rubbish in the road will have to pay a fine.
Baada ya miezi mitatu, mtaa umekuwa safi na watoto wagonjwa wamepungua.
After three months the street has become clean and fewer children are sick.
Mzee Salehe anasema mtaa safi unaanza nyumbani kwa kila mmoja wetu.
Mzee Salehe says a clean street starts at home with each one of us.
Mtaa jirani sasa unataka kuiga mpango huu.
The neighbouring street now wants to copy this plan.
